concerns.text: Tasks T045, T046, T047, and T048 (Phase 7: Physical Interpretation) implement Alfvén speed calculations, Lorentz transformations, and schematic diagrams. These capabilities are NOT present in spec.md (which limits scope to correlation, lag sweep, and sensitivity) nor in plan.md. These tasks represent scope creep and have no matching FR/SC/Plan element to satisfy.

Task T017 implements logic to calculate |L* - L_phys| (SC-002) but is marked with a comment 'FAILED: unspecified'. There is no active, executable task description or verification step for T017 that ensures SC-002 is satisfied. The implementation of SC-002 is effectively missing.

Task T043 (Polish) is marked with a comment 'FAILED: unspecified'. It is intended to verify artifacts against SC-001 to SC-005. Without an active, executable task to perform this verification, the Success Criteria (SC-001 through SC-005) lack a dedicated validation task in the execution plan.

Task T002 description contains a 'Rewritten passage' block and a 'The specific value to remove/generalize' note. This is editorial residue from a previous revision cycle and should be cleaned up to reflect the final state of the task.
